page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 80 dedicated physical cores with an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. Notably, the system is configured with a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled, providing dedicated physical execution resources for each virtual CPU.

The instance is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 9.6 GB per physical core. It does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. No graphics processing units are present on this instance type.

This instance family offers high memory density per core, which is suitable for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of hyperthreading. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a clear tradeoff, positioning this server specifically for memory-bound enterprise applications. Appropriate workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data-caching layers.
